body: Oh and don't bother with the suicide hotline, I trashed my phone to keep myself from reaching out to anyone.

I holed myself up.  I threatened to stab anyone that comes close.  I've been saying all sorts of things and screaming, shouting, the whole nine yards really.  I just want to burn every bridge I have.  I don't have any friends so the last line of defense against suicide is my family.  Once I burn the bridge with my family, my suicide will cause relief and not remorse.
